description:
Rear garden:

T1 - Pear - Completely remove mixed species vine/rose from crown. Reduce crown by 1m all round, to allow more light through to garden

T2 - Fig - Reduce laterals by 3m to suitable growth points. Bring height down by 1.5m

T3 - Cherry - Light formative prune

T4 - Birch - Reduce back overhang from neighbours garden to suitable growth points. Lift to give Cherry & Camellia sufficient space while retaining screening from properties at rear of garden

T5 - Camellia - Reduce height by 1.5m, light prune remaining foliage

T6 - Apple - Reduce crown all round by 2m

T7 - Cherry (on fence line) - Reduce back from neighbours garden by 1.5m. reduce height by 1m to ensure balanced finish

T8 - Persimmon - Reduce crown by 1m all  round to alleviate weight on framework and to give Bay sufficient space. Remove Rose growing through tree to suitable pruning points

T9 - Bay - Reduce height by 1.5m and trim to shape for more compact ornamental finish

Front garden:

T10 - Olive - Heavy reduction to reset framework to more manageable ornamental finish and to give sufficient clearance to Magnolia
